Overview

Chaves is a city in with a population of 17,535. A historic Roman town in northern Portugal known for its thermal springs, medieval castle, and Roman bridge. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 46.0.
